title: A description adds a condition
hook: Two stated cases: explore the subset relationship behind a conjunction.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the subset relationship behind a conjunction affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Joint, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the subset relationship behind a conjunction in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
